flow_method.scope: Private Docker network namespace; tc netem on loopback; half the nominal RTT per direction; no bandwidth shaping. Three sequential connections per setting; window order reversed at 20 ms.

pgo.training: H1 and TLS/H2; four routes; 64 KiB echo; 16 VUs, 4s each; graceful application exit. Training data is not comparative performance evidence.
pgo.control: Same temporary application source, implicit native target, no PGO flags. Product source is identical.

limitations: Shared three-CPU VM with unrelated service containers.
Socket CPU includes a broader cgroup interval than request timing. RSS is sampled, not a continuous peak.
Rejected trials remain in the CSV. Lower allocation counts do not guarantee lower RSS or faster sockets.
Full raw instrumentation, source copies and logs remain local ignored artifacts.
